description: This file contains the implementation of a socket-based adapter class for Zend_Http_Client, enabling HTTP communication over sockets in PHP. It defines the class Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket, including methods for configuration, connection management, data transmission, and response reading within the HTTP client context.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Client_Adapter_Socket
classes.description: A socket-based implementation of the Zend_Http_Client_Adapter interface, providing methods for establishing connections, sending HTTP requests, reading responses, and managing stream contexts using PHP stream functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor, initializes the adapter without specific configuration.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the adapter, accepting arrays or Zend_Config objects.

methods.name: setStreamContext
methods.description: Sets the stream context resource, either from an existing resource or an array of options.

methods.name: getStreamContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current stream context, creating a default one if none is set.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specified host and port, with optional SSL support.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request over the connected socket, including headers and body.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the HTTP response from the socket, handling headers, chunked transfer encoding, content-length, and streaming as appropriate.

methods.name: _checkSocketReadTimeout
methods.description: Checks if the socket read operation timed out and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: setOutputStream
methods.description: Sets a stream resource to which the response will be written.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that closes the socket unless persistence is configured.
